explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 85 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: Oxytocin has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-09-23 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 49 months.
A registered plant for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) was inspected and classified OAI on 2022-06-30, which was 85 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2022-09-23.
The same plant received an OAI classification letter dated 2024-04-30, 585 days after the shortage posting.
Another registered plant for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 3001833549) has a history of OAI inspections in 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11, with a Warning Letter issued 2012-02-22.
Current inventory at Corvale East is 81 vials at 6.8 vials per day (11.9 days on hand) and at Corvale General is 113 vials at 8.7 vials per day (13 days on hand).

The preferred alternative per protocol is oxytocin 10 units/mL from Par Health USA, LLC (manufactured at PH HEALTH), approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-16, requiring dose recalculation and pharmacist verification.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
